[[EXPERIMENT_TITLE]] – ÄKTA Chromatography Run Report

1. Experiment Information

Experiment ID: [[EXPERIMENT_ID]]

Process ID: [[PROCESS_ID]]

2. Start & End Date

Start Date: [[EXPERIMENT_DATE]]

End / Report Date: [[REPORT_DATE]]

3. Methods

3.1 Automated Workflow Description
  1. Manual Preparation
    • The run was initialized by pausing the system with the instruction: "Manually fill sample loop".
    • The sample loop was filled manually according to the experimental plan (sample type, volume, and buffer as defined outside this template).
  2. ÄKTA Pure – Protocol Execution
    • The ÄKTA Pure system executed a predefined chromatography method.
    • Sample monitoring signals included:
      • UV signal (uv1)
      • Conductivity (cond)
    • Sampling time resolution for recorded signals: 1 second (as configured in the workflow).
3.2 Run Parameters

The following run parameters were configured for this process (where applicable to the executed method):

Parameter Placeholder Description / Unit
Process ID [[PROCESS_ID]] Unique identifier of the ÄKTA process
Equilibration duration [[EQUILIBRATION_DURATION]] Equilibration phase duration (e.g. min)
Equilibration flow rate [[EQUILIBRATION_FLOW_RATE]] Flow rate during equilibration (e.g. mL/min)
Load/injection duration [[LOAD_INJECT_DURATION]] Time for sample loading/injection (e.g. min)
Load/injection flow rate [[LOAD_INJECT_FLOW_RATE]] Flow rate during loading/injection (e.g. mL/min)
Elution gradient duration [[ELUTE_GRADIENT_DURATION]] Total duration of the elution gradient (e.g. min)
Elution gradient start [[ELUTE_GRADIENT_GRADIENT_START]] Starting composition of gradient (e.g. %B)
Elution gradient end [[ELUTE_GRADIENT_GRADIENT_END]] Final composition of gradient (e.g. %B)
Wash duration [[WASH_DURATION]] Post-elution wash phase duration (e.g. min)
Wash flow rate [[WASH_FLOW_RATE]] Flow rate during wash (e.g. mL/min)
CIP duration [[CIP_DURATION]] Total or primary CIP phase duration (e.g. min)
CIP 2 hold duration [[CIP_2_HOLD_DURATION]] Hold time during CIP step 2 (e.g. min)
CIP 3 duration [[CIP_3_DURATION]] Duration of CIP step 3 (e.g. min)
CIP 4 duration [[CIP_4_DURATION]] Duration of CIP step 4 (e.g. min)
CIP 5 duration [[CIP_5_DURATION]] Duration of CIP step 5 (e.g. min)

4. Results

4.1 Chromatogram
[[PLOT_1]]

Figure 1: Chromatogram of the ÄKTA Pure run (UV and conductivity signals), corresponding to the selected file "chromatogram_{ID}.png". The image will be linked via an eLabFTW download URL at [[PLOT_1]].

4.2 Notes on Run Performance
  • Assess peak shape, retention time, and resolution based on the chromatogram.
  • Verify that equilibration, loading, washing, elution, and CIP phases match the configured durations and flow rates.
  • Document any deviations from the expected profile or anomalies observed during the run.
